# DJ Musta Music
# Uganda's #1 Free Music Streaming & Download Platform
# https://djmusta.com

## About
DJ Musta Music is Uganda's premier destination for streaming and downloading the hottest Ugandan music for free. The platform features kadongo kamu, gospel, afrobeat, dancehall, reggae, and all genres of Ugandan music.

## What We Offer
- Free music streaming and downloads
- 200+ Ugandan songs
- 100+ Ugandan artists
- Genres: Kadongo Kamu, Gospel, Afrobeat, Dancehall, R&B, Hip Hop, Reggae, Nonstops
- Music promotion services for Ugandan artists
